reason: A store that opens on November 1 has no Google Maps reviews yet, and I don't drive out to Westheimer for a place nobody I know has tried. I'll wait to see what people say about the fabric and the stitching first.
objection: Westheimer is a drive from where I live, and with zero reviews I have no idea if the crepe and embroidery hold up or just look good on TikTok.
would_change_my_mind: A few months of solid Google reviews with real photos, or a friend from the Hillcroft markets wearing one of their thobes to a wedding and it looking well made.
